items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1976-02-13
items.q: Like they once said about Jack T. Gordon, every note that he ever played on the trombone meant something.

ctx.x: Well, is there something else of his?

I don't know. I don't know of anything else. Of course, everybody knows he's wearing candle lights, you know. There's whole tones again, you see. Yeah. He eucalyzed that great. And this is also a pair.
